title: Workout Tracker — paired sport mastery avatar production briefs
status: Design handoff; production starts after switching to Light. No assets or variant UI generated by this brief.
shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional {variant} {sport_label} athlete for the {tier_label} tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. {identity} {stage} {palette} Outfit: {kit} Equipment: {equipment} Award: {award} Pose: {pose} {framing} Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve the same athlete's face, skin tone and hair identity within each variant across its eight-tier ladder, allowing the planned progression in age and presentation.

stages.bronze: Youth academy/developing athlete, approximately 12–14, modest practical kit, natural junior physique; no adult musculature or jewellery.
stages.silver: Older academy/developing athlete, approximately 15–17, practical kit, natural adolescent proportions.
stages.gold: Young adult competitive athlete, approximately 18–22, confident but natural physique.
stages.platinum: Established adult athlete, approximately 23–30; progression through kit and awards, not enlarged muscles.
stages.diamond: Established adult athlete, approximately 23–30; champion-level presentation and composed expression.
stages.elite: Established adult athlete, approximately 23–30; elite finish comes from excellent kit and awards, not glow.
stages.champion: Established adult athlete, approximately 23–30; highly accomplished champion, no exaggerated ageing or body growth.
stages.unreal: Established adult athlete, approximately 23–30, formal awards-night recognition; equal tailored trouser-suit quality for both variants.

framing.default: Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed.
framing.unreal: Square awards portrait, head to mid-thigh; hands and final award fully visible, 6–8% clear transparent margins, face and award dominate without touching the edges.
